advantage.reason: no advantage is claimed: the quantum arm's circuit is simulated classically on ten selection bits, so this is search quality at a fixed budget, not a computational speedup

surrogate.note: the surrogate is a quadratic approximation of a non-quadratic objective; its minimiser is reported separately from the best selection the arm scored, and the circuit probe records what probability the circuit itself put on the generating support, which the arm cannot compute because it does not know it

checks.name: budget_256:search_is_required
checks.requirement: the per-arm budget is smaller than the space it searches

checks.name: budget_256:every_arm_respects_the_budget
checks.requirement: no arm spent more than the declared budget

limitations: One synthetic system, one ten-term library, one noise level and one time step. Nothing here calibrates difficulty or transfers to another library.

The derivative is a centred finite difference of the observed velocity, so noise is amplified by differentiation. A smoothing or total-variation derivative estimator would change every number and was not measured.
Only the acceleration equation is discovered. The kinematic identity dx/dt = v is supplied, which is why the companion coordinate is reported and not counted.

The task is fair only in the benchmark sense: an exhaustive sweep confirms the penalised optimum is the generating support by a measured margin. A real discovery has no such oracle, so this is not evidence that discovery is easy in general.

The QAOA arm optimises a quadratic surrogate of a non-quadratic objective and runs on a dense statevector simulator. No hardware, no sampling noise in the angles, no device calibration, and the surrogate is lossy by construction -- the record keeps both the surrogate's minimiser and the selection the arm actually scored.

No quantum-advantage claim. The quantum arm's search space is ten bits and its circuit is simulated classically, so any comparison here concerns search quality at a fixed budget, never computational speed.
Approach C of the research programme (a quality-diversity sampler over circuits) was not tested. Only the differentiable-circuit and combinatorial-search ideas were.

RIME is used as an operator set on a relaxed selection vector, not through the native kernel in apedp_dyn.proposers.rime_proposer, and the GP arm evolves a set-building language rather than arithmetic expression trees. Both are stated in their modules.
Three seeds per arm per condition. That is enough to see a broken arm and not enough to estimate a per-arm variance, so the record reports counts and medians, not significance tests.
More than one budget is measured, but the space is the same; the record therefore says how the arms rank at those budgets and nothing about the budget where they rank stably.
